# Harshith Nayaka L — AI Workflow Engineer

> AI Workflow Engineer at DemandNXT (Bengaluru, India) who builds production AI systems that turn manual work into reliable automation: multi-model LLM pipelines, multi-modal applications, and structured-output engineering with validation and QA gates. Available for select freelance projects.

Harshith Nayaka L specialises in the unglamorous part of applied AI — making systems behave the same way on the hundredth run as on the first. Core areas: LLM integration and orchestration, multi-modal pipelines (voice, vision, text), output reliability via schema-constrained generation, full-stack AI applications, local and cloud inference (Google Cloud AI, Hugging Face, Ollama), and workflow automation with n8n. Building with code since 2022; reached the semi-finals of the Gen AI Exchange Hackathon 2025 (a national event with 270,000+ developers, organised by Google Cloud).

## Main pages

- [Home](https://my-portfolio-harshith.vercel.app/): Overview, selected work, capabilities, about, and contact.

## Case studies

- [Creative-Ops Pipeline](https://my-portfolio-harshith.vercel.app/work/creative-ops-pipeline): Flagship. A multi-model content pipeline that turns a one-line brief into validated, on-brand output using tiered model routing, schema-constrained generation, QA gates, and failure recovery.
- [CraftConnect](https://my-portfolio-harshith.vercel.app/work/craftconnect): Gen AI Exchange Hackathon 2025 semi-finalist. A multi-modal assistant letting artisans run an online storefront by talking and showing instead of typing, built on Gemini and Google Cloud.
- [Nova AI](https://my-portfolio-harshith.vercel.app/work/nova-ai): A deployed LLM chat app on Llama 3.1 8B that keeps the API token server-side behind a serverless proxy.
- [BlogSpace](https://my-portfolio-harshith.vercel.app/work/blogspace): A live full-stack blogging platform with JWT auth, role-based access, and an admin panel (React, Node, MongoDB).
- [AI Notes](https://my-portfolio-harshith.vercel.app/work/ai-notes): A notes app running DeepSeek R1 locally through Ollama, so inference never leaves the machine.
